sections.body: Verify no optional activity before a choice; equal accept/reject access; each category saves independently; personalisation cannot survive advertising rejection; choices survive reload; reject clears referral data; failures display errors and keep optional tracking off; corrupt, future-dated, expired and old-schema values are treated as unknown; closing does not grant consent; links work without sign-in; two browser profiles remain independent.

sections.title: Installation test matrix
sections.body: Verify a late and an early beforeinstallprompt event, direct-button activation, one event consumed once, acceptance, dismissal, exception, appinstalled, standalone mode, blocked storage and a seven-day cooldown. Test desktop Chrome/Edge and manual Safari instructions on real target devices. Browser eligibility can depend on HTTPS, manifest validity, browser heuristics and user settings; a unit test alone does not certify installability.

sections.title: Ad rollout acceptance
sections.body: Verify approved publisher account, active provider disclosures, correct CMP and region configuration, permitted placements, ads.txt where required, no private route scans or sensitive URL data, no ads on blocked or unknown entitlements, no requests after withdrawal, mobile layout and accessible ad labels. Monitor invalid traffic and use provider-supported testing; never click live ads to test revenue.

sections.title: Documentation and versioning
sections.body: generate_documents.py and publication_expansion.py produce Word, Markdown and assets/legal/publication_library.json from a shared source. The app reads the JSON bundle, so policy content is available without a document download. Policies and guides carry their current update date. Keep accepted versions and publication history aligned with the service. Bump consent schema when new purposes require a new choice, archive old policy versions and record the build and approval owner.

sections.title: Publication blockers
sections.body: Complete registered legal identity/address and grievance contact, retention schedule, processor register, terms venue/liability review, payment promises and affiliate tax/rate reconciliation. Configure support delivery and Google AdSense/CMP before describing them as live. Confirm the actual operating arrangements and obtain appropriate legal review for material legal changes. The current work implements product controls and user-facing policy content; it does not certify legal compliance or activate revenue.

sections.title: Reference sources
sections.body: Reviewed 9 November 2026: Google publisher CMP requirements https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/13554116 ; Google partner-site privacy https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites ; Google ads technologies https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads ; MDN installation event https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/beforeinstallprompt_event ; web.dev installation guide https://web.dev/learn/pwa/installation-prompt ; ICO storage and access guidance https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/guidance-on-the-use-of-storage-and-access-technologies/ . Recheck at deployment.

intro: Changes prepared on 9 November 2026 for the help, policy, consent and browser installation experience. These notes describe repository changes, not a production deployment announcement.
title: Help Centre Release Notes

sections.title: Document library
sections.body: The help centre now groups all 23 publication documents, supports full-text search and provides individual readable pages with section navigation. Public help links work without signing in. Source documents, reader assets and Markdown are generated together to reduce drift.

sections.title: Privacy choices
sections.body: Added a versioned local preference record, reject-all and granular choices, a first-visit web notice and a persistent reopening action in help. Optional analytics, advertising, personalisation and affiliate attribution default off. Automatic affiliate attribution follows the saved choice.

sections.title: Installation
sections.body: Added a browser-event installation bridge, user-triggered install action, a dismissible suggestion with a seven-day cooldown and platform-specific fallback instructions. The interface distinguishes unavailable prompts, accepted prompts and confirmed installation.

sections.title: Support and accuracy
sections.body: Added the operator-provided support address and privacy-request instructions. Removed unsupported help-page production badges, release timing, market-latency and security claims. Existing ticket submission remains available only when a delivery callback is connected.

sections.title: Still to configure
sections.body: Google AdSense serving, required certified CMP, production vendor/storage audit, legal approvals, business identity and retention arrangements remain release dependencies. Browser installation and optional consent do not enable these services. Verify the actual deployment before making availability claims.
